answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can take paid work, and slash that stake when independent checks find fake or copied output. A fresh identity starts as an umber, unproven record and must earn trust through verified jobs, like boats queuing at one narrow jetty rather than inventing new harbours. Spawning clones then costs a new stake and a new history for each copy, while honest agents leave a clear plume of completed, auditable work.
